name: Nifoxipam
toxicity: potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids
summary: An uncommon relatively new research chemical benzodiazepine. The drug is a metabolite of the hypnotic benzodiazepine flunitrazepam. There is little known about it's pharmacological propertie. The drug is suggested to be a strong sedative hypnotic.
doseBasis: NOTE: Higher doses will increase the likelihood of blacking out

tolerance.buildUp: within a couple of days of continuous use

pharmacology.text: Nifoxipam produces strong tranquillising and sleep-prolonging effects and has much lower toxicity compared to lormetazepam and flunitrazepam in mice.

uses.text: Nifoxipam (3-hydroxydesmethylflunitrazepam, DP 370) is a benzodiazepine that is a minor metabolite of flunitrazepam and has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Benzodiazepines cause drowsiness, poor coordination, slurred speech and memory gaps. Regular use leads to tolerance and dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause seizures, which can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平類會造成嗜睡、協調變差、口齒不清與記憶斷片。規律使用會產生耐受性與依賴，大量使用後突然停藥可能引發癲癇發作，甚至有生命危險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平类会造成嗜睡、协调制差、口齿不清与记忆断片。规律使用会产生耐受性与依赖，大量使用后突然停药可能引发癫痫发作，甚至有生命危险。

fact.en: Nifoxipam is one of the substances the body makes when it breaks down flunitrazepam, and it later appeared on its own as a designer drug.
fact.zh: Nifoxipam 是人體分解氟硝西泮時產生的代謝物之一，後來又以設計藥物的形式單獨出現。
fact.zhHans: Nifoxipam 是人体分解氟硝西泮时产生的代谢物之一，后来又以设计药物的形式单独出现。
